purpose: Teach: 催眠/列挙/傾斜/海賊/聴覚/電磁波/服用/墜落

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、催眠的なマーケで顧客を惑わすな
lines.en: Don't use hypnotic marketing tactics to confuse our customers.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative. Clean attack on the opening. Steady eye contact. Each clause deliberate and unrushed. Weight behind each direction without raising volume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の強みを列挙して、プレゼンに使います
lines.en: Understood. We'll compile our key strengths and use them for the presentation.
lines.style: Respectful, focused. Brief pause after the agreement, then methodical enumeration of the plan. Even pace, note-taking energy. Showing competence through clarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場の傾斜に流されない経営しろ
lines.en: Don't let our company get swept along by market trends. Lead with conviction.
lines.style: Steady, emphasizing principle. Slight pause before 'conviction' to let it land. Not harsh—paternal. The tone of someone who has seen companies fail by following instead of leading.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海賊版コピー商品の取り締まりも進めます
lines.en: Understood. We're also strengthening our counterfeit product enforcement.
lines.style: Reporting cadence. Matter-of-fact. Quick confirmation, then the update delivered with quiet pride in the action already underway. No dramatization needed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、聴覚弱者向け商品も開発しろ
lines.en: Develop products for people with hearing impairments too.
lines.style: Direct, brief. No apology in the instruction. Assumes compliance. The tone of a leader who names what needs doing and trusts the team to do it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、電磁波対策も進めております
lines.en: Understood. We're also implementing electromagnetic field protections throughout the office.
lines.style: Steady update. Inclusive 'we're' ownership. Calm, factual. The rhythm of someone checking boxes on a larger vision. No defensiveness about the scope.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 長期服用される薬の販路を拡大しろ
lines.en: Expand our distribution channels for long-term pharmaceutical products.
lines.style: Clear, strategic. Slight emphasis on 'expand.' Not rushed. The tone of someone thinking several quarters ahead. Measured, not frantic.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。航空機の墜落事故に関する保険商品も検討中です
lines.en: Understood. We're also exploring insurance products for aviation incident coverage.
lines.style: Calm wrap-up. Final item in a longer list, delivered with the same steady professionalism as the rest. No uncertainty. The phrase lands as completion, not as an afterthought.
